inspiration: Ground drop as a small physical object: a fixed-step gravity sim at 60 steps per second, capped at 120 frames, with a bounce factor and a speed damping, that stops when the bounce is small. A drop lands, bounces about twice, and settles. Shadow is drawn at a quarter of the entity shadow so it does not stretch north of the item sprite (game/items.go lines 55-60 and the loop near line 815).

Prestige aura as three stacked layers: a ground ring, a body glow and a floating bubble, each with its own effect id, synced every frame from the actor's level. The aura carries a 24 hour lifetime (game/level99_aura.go lines 11 and 19 onward). Good model for a status aura that is readable at 375 wide.

Damage numbers as per-digit billboards: digits are cut from one sprite strip with a 2 px gap, then floated up with a z-lift, scale and alpha curve chosen by the kind of hit (game/damage_numbers.go lines 113-155 and 187-232).

Hit ring as a short timed flat ring: inner and outer radius grow over a few frames, a fade-out frame ends it, and a particle burst sits on top (db/effects_hit.go lines 8-30). Cheap and clear at phone size.

Cylinder effect as a column of the same texture drawn several times with staggered start offsets, so one light pillar reads as many (game/effects_cylinder.go lines 12-30). Useful for teleports and boss arrival.

Look-by-id maps: monster and item tables map numeric ids to names and to art resource names (db/item_tables.go lines 8464-10909). The catalogue can keep the id-to-look split so a new look does not change the item row.

Layered data folders: a DATA.INI lists archives in priority order and the first archive that has a file wins (docs/client-setup.md, GRF archives section). A priority list is a clean way to let zone or event packs override base data.

briefs.label: Stepped drop bounce
briefs.why: A dropped item reads as a physical object. It lands, bounces about twice and settles, so loot feels like it fell, not appeared.
briefs.keep: fixed-step gravity; bounce ratio on each landing; stop when the bounce is small; shadow at a quarter size
briefs.change: drops hover on a rarity-coloured light column instead of a bounce; bounce ratio set per rarity tier; ground ring instead of a shadow ellipse

briefs.label: Prestige ring aura
briefs.why: Three stacked layers (ground, body, bubble) make a status read at a distance and stay clear at 375 wide.
briefs.keep: three layers with separate timing; synced to the actor each frame; long lifetime tied to a level
briefs.change: colour ramp by prestige tier; rotating glyph ring instead of bubbles; the aura pulses on fight start only

briefs.label: Kind-coloured damage digits
briefs.why: Per-digit floaters let a combo read as a stack of numbers, and the kind colour says what happened without words.
briefs.keep: digits composed from one strip with a small gap; float up with z-lift; fade by kind colour
briefs.change: two-frame pop scale on each digit; crit digits shake sideways; a hit-count tag stacks under the number

briefs.label: Flat hit ring
briefs.why: A short expanding ring plus particles gives impact at a glance with very few sprites.
briefs.keep: ring grows and fades over a few frames; particle burst on top
briefs.change: ring colour by element; a three-frame hitstop flash in the ring centre; ring is drawn flat on the ground, not as a sprite sheet
